additional_info.subject: RE: ID0393933-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000835] Failsafe mode CRM:00643001149
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0393933 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Please arrange for site intervention to check the router's feasibility. After the reboot, the chargers go offline and enter Failsafe mode. Kindly bring a spare router with you, and if needed, reset the router and reconfigure it using the companion tool.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma

Hello,
I went onsite on Tuesday 10
Th
December and I was able to get the OCPP communication back in the charger by changing the SIM Card and by unplugging and plugging again the Ethernet cable which was not well connected. The charger is now Online OCPP and SCB.
I think the French team wanted to change the router OCPP. Maybe we can wait a little because The charger is available now.
Thank you,
Best Regards,
